challenge.method: Withhold the SPDX name and test whether the publisher evidence distinguishes this edition from the Public Domain Mark and a summary of CC0.
challenge.results: The README identifies unit “zero” and version “1.0”. The file expressly identifies itself as legal code and contains an owner's operative waiver and fallback license. A mark describing an existing public-domain status or a deed summarizing the instrument would not account for those operative provisions.
